title: Reschedule a client meeting
situation: You must move tomorrow's 10:00 meeting because of a clash.
task: Apologise and offer two new times.

title: Invite a team to a workshop
situation: You are organising a half-day workshop next month.
task: Invite them and explain the purpose, date and preparation.

title: Book a room
situation: You need a large meeting room for a visiting client.
task: Request the room with date, time, and equipment.

title: Ask for a quick call
situation: An email thread has become confusing.
task: Suggest a short call and propose a time.

title: Decline a meeting
situation: You cannot attend a meeting you are not needed in.
task: Decline politely and offer to send your input.

title: Cross-time-zone planning
situation: You need a regular time that works for Tokyo and London.
task: Suggest options and ask for preferences.

title: Confirm an appointment
situation: You have a business appointment next week.
task: Confirm the date, time and the documents needed.

title: Cancel an event
situation: A company webinar is cancelled because the speaker is ill.
task: Announce it, apologise and explain what happens next.

title: Remind about a deadline
situation: Timesheets are due on Friday and many are missing.
task: Send a friendly reminder.

title: Arrange a site visit
situation: You want to visit the supplier's factory.
task: Propose dates and ask what is needed for the visit.

title: Apologise for a late delivery
situation: A shipment is eight days late because of a customs problem.
task: Apologise, explain, and offer compensation.

title: Answer a price question
situation: A customer asks why your premium plan costs more.
task: Explain the differences clearly and helpfully.

title: Refuse a refund
situation: He asked for a refund after the 30-day period.
task: Say no kindly and offer an alternative.

title: Welcome a new client
to: Ms. Teresa Lopez, a new client
situation: Her company has just signed a contract.
task: Welcome her and explain the next steps.

title: Correct a wrong invoice
situation: You sent an invoice with the wrong amount.
task: Apologise and attach the correct invoice.

title: Report an outage
situation: Your service was down for three hours last night.
task: Explain what happened and what you are doing.

title: Ask for a testimonial
situation: A project finished successfully.
task: Ask if they would write a short review.

title: Follow up after a complaint
situation: Her complaint was solved last week.
task: Check that she is satisfied now.

title: Announce a price increase
situation: Prices will rise by 8 percent in January.
task: Explain the change without losing their trust.

title: End a client relationship
situation: Your company can no longer support this account.
task: End it professionally and explain the handover.

title: Ask for a deadline extension
situation: You need three more days to finish a report.
task: Ask for more time and give a reason and a new date.

title: Request a day off
situation: You need Friday off for a family event.
task: Ask politely and explain how your work is covered.

title: Ask a colleague for data
situation: You need last quarter's cost figures.
task: Ask for specific data and say when you need it.

title: Request a budget
situation: You want budget for a training course.
task: Explain the cost and the benefit.

title: Ask for an introduction
situation: You want to meet someone at their company.
task: Ask for an introduction without being pushy.

title: Request a reference
situation: You are applying for a new job.
task: Ask for a reference and give the details.

title: Ask for new equipment
situation: Your laptop is too slow for your work.
task: Justify a replacement.

title: Ask for help on a project
situation: You need their expertise for two days.
task: Ask for help and be clear about the time.

title: Request access
situation: You need access to the customer database.
task: Explain why and what level of access is needed.

title: Ask for feedback on a draft
situation: You wrote an important proposal.
task: Ask for specific feedback by a certain date.

title: Weekly status update
situation: One task is finished, one is late, one is blocked.
task: Give a clear, short status update.

title: Announce a new team member
situation: A new analyst joins next Monday.
task: Introduce the person warmly.

title: Share meeting notes
situation: You took notes at a planning meeting.
task: Summarise decisions and actions with owners.

title: Handover before holiday
situation: You are away for two weeks.
task: Describe open tasks and contacts.

title: Announce a process change
situation: Expense claims now go through a new system.
task: Explain what changes and when.

title: Share good results
situation: Your team beat its quarterly target.
task: Share the news and thank the team.

title: Report a delay
situation: A key delivery will slip by two weeks.
task: Explain the delay, the impact and the plan.

title: Escalate a blocker
situation: Another team has blocked you for two weeks.
task: Escalate professionally without blaming.

title: Office closure notice
situation: The office will be closed for repairs on Thursday.
task: Explain and say how to work that day.

title: Announce your departure
situation: It is your last week at the company.
task: Say goodbye and share your contact details.

title: Disagree with a decision
situation: You think a new policy will hurt customers.
task: Disagree respectfully and suggest an alternative.

title: Admit a mistake
situation: You sent confidential data to the wrong person.
task: Admit it, apologise and explain the steps taken.

title: Chase an unpaid invoice
situation: An invoice is 45 days overdue.
task: Ask for payment firmly but politely.

title: Complain to a supplier
situation: The last delivery was damaged.
task: Complain clearly and ask for a solution.

title: Say no to extra work
situation: They keep giving you tasks outside your role.
task: Refuse politely and suggest the right person.

title: Give difficult feedback
situation: Their reports contain many errors.
task: Be honest, kind and specific.

title: Respond to an angry email
situation: She wrote an angry email and copied your manager.
task: Reply calmly and move the matter forward.

title: Report a colleague's behaviour
situation: A colleague often makes offensive comments.
task: Describe the facts professionally.

title: Reject a candidate
situation: A good candidate was not selected.
task: Reject kindly and encourage them.

title: Withdraw from a commitment
situation: You can no longer attend a joint event.
task: Withdraw and limit the damage.

title: Cold outreach
situation: You have never spoken to this company.
task: Introduce your product briefly and ask for a call.

title: Follow up after a demo
situation: You showed your product yesterday.
task: Thank her and suggest next steps.

title: Send a quotation
situation: They asked for a price for 200 units.
task: Present the price, terms and validity.

title: Negotiate a discount
situation: You want 10 percent off for a large order.
task: Make a persuasive case.

title: Win back a customer
situation: They left six months ago.
task: Invite them back with a reason.

title: Invite to a trade fair
situation: Your company has a stand at an industry fair.
task: Invite them and give details.

title: Propose a partnership
situation: Your products could work together.
task: Propose the idea and the benefit.

title: Chase a silent prospect
situation: He has not replied in three weeks.
task: Follow up without being annoying.

title: Announce a new product
situation: You are launching a new feature.
task: Announce it and focus on benefits.

title: Thank a customer for an order
situation: They placed their first big order.
task: Thank them and confirm delivery details.

title: Apply for a job
situation: You saw a job advertisement that suits you.
task: Write a short application email.

title: Follow up after an interview
situation: You had an interview yesterday.
task: Thank her and restate your interest.

title: Accept a job offer
situation: You received an offer you want.
task: Accept and confirm the start date.

title: Decline a job offer
situation: You chose another company.
task: Decline politely and keep the relationship.

title: Negotiate your salary
situation: The offer is lower than you hoped.
task: Ask for more with good reasons.

title: Resign from your job
situation: You are leaving in four weeks.
task: Write a professional resignation.

title: Ask about an application
situation: Three weeks have passed with no news.
task: Ask politely about the status.

title: Ask for a pay rise
situation: You have taken on more responsibility.
task: Request a meeting and summarise your reasons.

title: Network with an alumni
situation: They work at a company you admire.
task: Ask for a short chat about their career.

title: Ask for an internal transfer
situation: You want to move to another department.
task: Explain your wish without seeming unhappy.

title: Start a new project
situation: A new project starts next month.
task: Introduce the goals, timeline and roles.

title: Change the scope
situation: She asked for extra features.
task: Explain the effect on cost and time.

title: Request approval
situation: You need sign-off before spending money.
task: Ask clearly for a decision.

title: Ask a supplier for a quote
situation: You need 500 custom boxes.
task: Ask for a quote with exact details.

title: Clarify requirements
situation: Some requirements are unclear.
task: List your questions clearly.

title: Close a project
situation: The project finished on time.
task: Confirm completion and thank people.

title: Report a safety issue
situation: A fire exit in your office is blocked.
task: Report it clearly and urgently.

title: Introduce two people
situation: They should work together.
task: Introduce them and explain why.

title: Request a contract change
situation: A clause needs to be changed.
task: Explain the change and why.

title: Share a risk
situation: A supplier may go out of business.
task: Describe the risk and options.

title: Book a business trip
situation: You must go to Berlin next month.
task: Request flights and a hotel with details.

title: Report a travel problem
situation: Your flight was cancelled before a key meeting.
task: Explain and suggest a solution.

title: Claim expenses
situation: A receipt was lost during your trip.
task: Explain and ask how to claim.

title: Host a visitor
situation: A client is coming to your office.
task: Share the agenda and practical information.

title: Invite a speaker
situation: You are organising a conference.
task: Invite them and explain the details.

title: Thank a host
situation: You visited their office last week.
task: Thank them and mention next steps.

title: Arrange a team dinner
situation: You are planning a dinner to celebrate.
task: Invite them and ask about dietary needs.

title: Complain to a hotel
situation: Your room was not as booked.
task: Complain politely and ask for a refund.

title: Request a visa letter
situation: You need a letter for a visa.
task: Ask for the letter with the necessary details.

title: Share conference notes
situation: You attended a useful conference.
task: Summarise what you learned.

title: Introduce yourself
situation: It is your first week at the company.
task: Introduce yourself in a friendly way.

title: Sick day
situation: You woke up ill today.
task: Tell your manager and explain your work.

title: Thank a colleague
situation: She helped you with a hard task.
task: Thank her sincerely and specifically.

title: Congratulate a promotion
situation: Peter was promoted.
task: Congratulate him warmly.

title: Condolences
situation: A colleague's father has died.
task: Write a short, kind message.

title: Report a broken printer
situation: The second-floor printer has been broken for days.
task: Report it and ask when it will be fixed.

title: Ask about company policy
situation: You want to know the parental leave policy.
task: Ask your questions clearly.

title: Organise a farewell gift
situation: A colleague is leaving soon.
task: Ask for contributions discreetly.

title: Say you received the wrong email
situation: You received an email meant for someone else.
task: Let them know politely.

title: Late to work
situation: Train problems mean you will be an hour late.
task: Inform your manager briefly.
